shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure / human head with face
stone monolithic upright form as figure
arms/hands rendered against the body (A body, B relief limbs)
justification: Both depict an upright monolithic anthropomorphic subject — A is a fully three-dimensional human head and torso with a large staring face, while B is a flat pillar whose surface carries low-relief imagery (rows of quadruped-like animals, a bird-headed creature, a fox or canid, a large bird, and a band of zigzag/comb pattern). The shared content is only the generic idea of a human-like standing form; A has no animals, no relief scene and no ornamental bands, and B has no rendered human face, so the specific iconography differs almost entirely.
